Nora K: Anyone else delayed by the drawbridge this morning? It opened for a freighter at 7:12 and traffic is backed to the ramp.
Samir P: Yep, got stuck at the onramp for like 15 mins. If you planned to take the Redwood shuttle, it will be ~10 min late.
TransitBot: Alert: Drawbridge lift caused traffic delay on Hwy 80 northbound. Shuttle pickups delayed ~10-15 minutes.
Tess Y: Fog is crazy near the waterfront too. Visibility down to half a block.
Eli V: Might WFH — roads look dicey and parking is a nightmare with detours.
Nora K: @Eli V If anyone needs to borrow my Clipper for today, DM me. I live a block from 4th & Folsom.
Samir P: Could use the clipper if it's free, thanks!
SnackBot: Office snack update: bananas low, instant oats stocked. Coffee: medium. ETA restock 12:00.
Tess Y: Also FYI, the bike lockers by the garage are closed due to maintenance.
Samir P: Anyone want a ride from Potrero Hill? I have room for two, leaving at 8:10.
Eli V: @Samir P I can take one seat, thanks.
Nora K: Meme: "When the ferry cancels but your optimism is still scheduled" (posted GIF) :joy:
Tess Y: Vote: in-person standup or remote? Reply "in" or "remote".
Eli V: remote
Samir P: in (slightly delayed)
Nora K: remote
TransitBot: Update: Ferry F3 resuming limited service at 9:00. Expect 20-30 min delays.
Samir P: Thanks for the heads-up. Heading out now, will DM about the Clipper.
Nora K: Safe commutes everyone, keep this thread updated if things change. :thumbsup:
